_howToEdit: Sample tiles for the Try Demo buttons on the How to Play page. They never affect the real board.
"row" sets which value the demo tile shows (0 = 10 points, 2 = 30 points, and so on).
A category can have a list of demo tiles: each Try Demo click shows the next one.
Demo timers match the real game (set in content.json). To speed up the Main Kaun? demo, add "characterSecondsPerClue": 5 here.

movie.plot: A nervous clownfish loses his only son when the boy is captured by a diver and taken to a fish tank in a dentist's office in Sydney. Determined to bring him home, the worried father crosses the whole ocean. Along the way he teams up with a cheerful blue fish who cannot remember anything for more than a few seconds, surfs the current with a group of laid-back sea turtles, and escapes from sharks who have sworn off eating fish.
